gloss: collection of famous sayings; book of quotations

definitions.gloss: collection of famous sayings; book of quotations; anthology of notable quotes
definitions.explanation: A compiled collection of memorable or wise sayings from famous people. Available as books, websites, or social media content.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{名言|めいげん}→名言：20185_meigen⟧ (famous saying; wise words) + {集|しゅう} (collection; compilation). A common book genre and popular content category online.

THE ～{集|しゅう} PATTERN:
- {詩集|ししゅう}: poetry collection
- {句集|くしゅう}: haiku collection
- ⟦{短編集|たんぺんしゅう}→短編集：28528_tanpenshuu⟧: short story collection
- ⟦{写真集|しゃしんしゅう}→写真集：19947_shashinshuu⟧: photo book
- {作品集|さくひんしゅう}: collected works

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名言集|めいげんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{編|あ}む→編む：00002_amu⟧: to compile a collection of quotes
- {名言集|めいげんしゅう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{引用|いんよう}する→引用する：26928_inyousuru⟧: to quote from a book of quotations
- ⟦{偉人|いじん}→偉人：15126_ijin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名言集|めいげんしゅう}: quotes from great people

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {格言集|かくげんしゅう}: collection of maxims — more focused on moral or practical proverbs
- {語録|ごろく}: collected sayings — often the sayings of one specific person
